tasks.short: Monitor rules and safety and manage unruly patrons

steps.what: Monitor activities for rules and safety, and arrange removal of unruly patrons

tasks.design: Retain direct safety monitoring and proportionate intervention by the attendant. Existing rules in the {DOCS} and ordinary staff communication support this work without replacing observation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safety and behaviour decisions depend on the unfolding physical situation.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change is needed in this boundary.
tasks.still_hard: De-escalating a concern while protecting other patrons.
tasks.human_edge: The attendant notices context, communicates clearly and calls the right help.
tasks.altitude: Monitoring time and intervention authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review how a difficult patron situation was escalated

evidence.claim: Direct monitoring and intervention remain human work; ticketing capability does not establish a saving for safety observation.

assumptions: Boundary is focal attendant monitoring and escalation time, not security staff removal time or separate incident reporting.
Attendant observes activities and behaviour directly. No structured unruly-patron flag or machine classification is introduced.
Existing native document access remains sufficient; no new recording or upkeep is added, so incremental work is zero.
research_questions: Which situations need faster human escalation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0. Routine monitoring and difficult patron incidents both retain the attendant's time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture attendance, sales, receipts, reservations or repair details at their source
Compile attendance, sales, receipts, reservations and repair records for the shift
Check the shift record against receipts and unresolved activity entries

tasks.design: Use native reporting in the {OTHER} attraction ticketing system for attendance and sales. Capture reservations and repair events in a linked {OTHER} facility record, then deterministically compile the shift record while the attendant retains source entry and reconciliation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Separate shift records can repeat facts already entered in ticketing and facility logs.
tasks.enabler_now: Cross-channel ticketing reports exist; a small deterministic mapping can combine the remaining explicit fields.
tasks.still_hard: Missing repair details, reversed sales and differences between admissions and ticket sales.
tasks.human_edge: The attendant investigates gaps instead of treating every source entry as complete.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate compilation, with unchanged source capture and reconciliation duties.

reach.task: Review unresolved repair and receipt exceptions
reach.learn: Event status definitions and reconciliation limits

evidence.claim: Convious offers one ticketing back end for web shop, gate till and kiosks with reporting across channels. This supports ticketing reports, not repair records or measured labour savings.
Combining explicit ticketing and repair fields into a shift record is a proposed deterministic design.

assumptions: Boundary is source capture and a duplicate shift compilation. If the source events are also counted in ticket admission or payment tasks, assign that capture once in the roll-up.

Attendant s1 produces checked event ID, type, timestamp, location, transaction amount/status or reservation dates; for repairs also equipment ID, observed issue and unresolved status. All capture, including repair coding, retains its 50 hours.

Machine s2 consumes only those checked entries and configured event definitions. It deduplicates IDs and groups by shift; incomplete or unmatched entries are explicitly flagged for s3, never silently filled.
No new customer or supplier entry is required. Existing ticketing runtime is not a human saving. Test native combined reports before adding a mapping.
If no duplicate shift compilation exists, the design earns no saving. Manual compilation is the fallback on missing feeds; actual exception time must fit s3 before adoption.
unknowns: Whether a duplicate shift record exists
research_questions: Can native reporting remove duplicate compilation after full source capture and reconciliation are included?

already_counted.description: Reconcile the generated record and resolve missing or reversed entries

incremental.description: Maintain event mappings and monitor compilation failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=50+0+20=70. Gross 30 less 2 upkeep gives net 28. High requires a separate 30-hour compilation slice and reliable checked source fields. Low covers native reports already used or manual fallback; capture and checking retain all their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain equipment inventory and handle equipment

steps.what: Store, retrieve, assemble and disassemble equipment while checking inventory condition
Update inventories with checked equipment locations, quantities and condition

tasks.design: Keep equipment handling and inspection unchanged. Configure a short inventory form in the {OTHER} facility records system so the attendant captures checked locations and condition without rewriting item descriptions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Inventory notes may repeat item descriptions after physical movement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native item lists and forms can reduce that small record slice.
tasks.still_hard: Actual location, damage and safe assembly must be checked physically.
tasks.human_edge: The attendant handles and checks the equipment itself.
tasks.altitude: Nearly the same week; a small inventory update becomes simpler.

reach.task: Confirm equipment needed for a planned session

evidence.claim: A native inventory form can reduce repeated descriptions but does not move or assemble equipment. The small saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary includes equipment handling and its small inventory update, not a new maintenance programme.

Attendant s1 produces observed location, count and condition through physical checks. In s2 the attendant enters item ID, location, quantity, condition and movement time; capture, review and exceptions retain 8 hours.
No structured condition flag is inferred from a scan. Missing item codes or uncertain condition require manual notes.
Test native inventory lists before custom code; only description reuse reduces time. Physical work retains all 90 hours.
unknowns: Whether inventory recording occupies even 10 percent
research_questions: Does the short form save time after actual location and condition capture?

already_counted.description: Capture checked inventory facts and handle unknown items

incremental.description: Maintain inventory form and item names

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=90+8=98. Gross 2 less 1 upkeep is net 1. Low assumes existing efficient records or almost entirely physical work; high requires the stated 10-hour note slice.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Receive or scan tickets presented by patrons at the entrance
Verify ticket validity and record collection or use before admission
Admit patrons after ticket checks and resolve entry exceptions

tasks.design: Configure the {OTHER} ticketing system to show validity and prior use for a scanned identifier. The attendant retains ticket presentation, checks the result and admits patrons or resolves exceptions; no self-service gate or biometric decision is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff may repeat date, entitlement and previous-use checks across screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Central ticketing records can support a single validity view.
tasks.still_hard: Unreadable tickets, offline operation, re-entry and disputed entitlements.
tasks.human_edge: The attendant helps patrons through exceptions and checks circumstances before admitting them.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated validity lookup; admission and queue interaction remain human.

reach.task: Resolve a duplicate-use ticket with the ticket office
reach.learn: Re-entry rules and ticket status definitions

evidence.claim: Convious provides a shared ticketing back end across web, gate till and kiosks. The proposed staffed ticket-check workflow and its saving are separate design assumptions.
A configured validity view can reduce repeated ticket checks while preserving human admission and exceptions.

assumptions: Boundary is staffed ticket checking and admission; no reduction in physical supervision, ticket-presentation time or patron effort is claimed.

Ticket office or ordinary online sale produces ticket ID, venue, entitlement, valid interval and status through unchanged ticket issuance. Existing use events come from normal entrance processing. No additional producer labour is assumed.

Attendant s1 captures the presented identifier by scan or manual entry, retaining all 35 hours. s2 checks the entitlement and status within 21 retained hours; failed scans, stale status or offline operation use the existing manual exception route.
Test native ticket validation before custom code. A ticket-validity result does not establish ride safety eligibility or replace separate safety checks.
research_questions: Does one validity view reduce repeated lookup while preserving accurate admission and helpful exceptions?

already_counted.description: Check ticket results and resolve validity exceptions
Confirm admission and handle entry circumstances

incremental.description: Check validity settings after ticket-rule changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact presented ticket ID, current entitlement and checked-use outcome for this entry attempt; changes or a new attempt require a fresh check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=35+21+30=86. Gross 14 less 1 upkeep gives net 13. Low assumes an existing single-screen check; high requires repeated validity checks within the 35-hour slice. Presentation and admission work retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce duplicate activity compilation and selected record navigation while retaining safety monitoring and physical service.
reach: Review unresolved activity exceptions with an entertainment supervisor
Coordinate equipment needs with a recreation worker
skills_to_grow: Check ticket and activity source quality
Recognise when a system result needs human investigation
role.ambitious_version: Keep a checked facility activity record that helps staff resolve exceptions without reducing direct supervision.
